the lung function of male adolescents aged ≥17 years, living in the rural area of Tanzania, was influenced by socio-economic status, which was associated with body build parameters in younger and with SES in older adolescents.
the socioeconomic status is associated with lung function in adolescents.
in adolescents aged <18, body build parameters, and not the SES, determine lung function.

the relationship between socio-economic status and lung function.
the influence of socio-economic status on lung function in male adolescents in Tanzania, a country with a low socio-economic status.
the influence of the socio-economic status on lung function in male adolescents in Tanzania.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the lung function of adolescents, especially in the age range of 17.5-24.5, is significantly influenced by the socio-economic status, and that the lung function in adolescents with a low socio-economic status may not reflect the lung function in adults with the same socio-economic status.
lung function in male adolescents in Tanzania is dependent on the SES and body build, and is greater in those with higher SES and greater body build.
the socio-economic factors are an important determinant of the pulmonary health in adolescents, and that their assessment should be included in the epidemiological and public-health studies.

the socio-economic factors should be considered when lung function is being measured in adolescents, especially in the developing countries.
the socio-economic level is a determinant of lung function, particularly in the older age group.
the socio-economic factors should be taken into consideration when assessing lung function in epidemiologic and public health programs.

socio-economic status should be taken into consideration when lung function is evaluated in the epidemiological and public-health context, especially in developing countries.
